audience: pest-control companies that run their sites, orders and visits in PestScan

useCases.title: Review infestations found at a site
useCases.text: Read the infestations recorded at a location, filtered by date, pest type or survey. Open the location for its full details.

useCases.title: Check materials used against completed orders
useCases.text: List the completed order sheets, then read the materials used per visit in the same period.

useCases.title: Plan technician visits for a date range
useCases.text: List the appointments in a date range, with the employees on each one. Use the employee list to match ids to names.

useCases.title: Review bait station records and advice for a site
useCases.text: List the bait stations of a location, optionally from a date. Then read the inspector recommendations for the same location.

useCases.title: Find a customer and its locations
useCases.text: List the customers with their ids, then list the locations with their customer id to match them.
